item.coloph: mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' ye shes kyi gsung gi rten du gshen gyi btsun pa rdzu 'phrul ye shes kyis bzhengs pa 'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog/

zhes pa'i mi rtag dang gnas lugs kyi mgur ma 'di/ rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyi thugs bzhed dang / bsam gtan bzang mos bskul phyir/ mdo smad sde bzhi yi dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i sa gnas yongs ba nas rnal 'byor wer ya drung mu yi (yis) 'phral du sug bris bgyis pa'i don ni slob ma rnams kyis don nyams su rtogs par mang+ga lam// bI dzi yA smar ro bkra shis zhal gro byin che dge legs 'phel//
